x: Mal Robinson on the last lap was clearly not at his best; but with Card (TVH) chasing George Knight (Essex) ahead it was a tough proposition, and we finished 4th.
He was forced to give way to Card of Thames Valley and we finished the leg in 3rd place, 1 min and 44 secs behind Portsmouth(Tulloh) and 15 secs behind TVH.
Card (T.V.H.) was a clear leader for 4 miles but faded badly enabling Pat, who had run a steady race, to gain just one more place and finish second in 30:10.2 - 18.6 seconds behind Major of Woodford.
At the end of the first leg, Card of the home club held a four secs. advantage over our own John Thresher, with Reading some eighty yards behind, closely followed by Highgate, Ealing and Polytechnic.
